title: PickupLocation
description: The location information where the fulfillment is designated to be pickup from. Mandatory when the delivery method of the fulfillment is `pickup`.

location_id.description: The unique identifier for the address. You can find or create the corresponding value [here](https://organization.automizely.com/warehouses).

opening_hours.description: Opening hours information of the pickup location.

Address_with_coordinate.v1.description: The physical address and contact information of the location. For Location resources, `first_name` and `last_name` are joined into one contact name on write; on read, the full contact name is returned as `first_name` and `last_name` is empty. The `type` field is accepted by the schema but not used for Location resources — omit it on write; on read it is always empty.
Address_with_coordinate.v1.title: AddressWithCoordinate

street_1.title: The Street_1 Schema
street_1.description: First line of the street address.

street_2.title: The Street_2 Schema
street_2.description: Second line of the street address.

street_3.title: The Street_3 Schema
street_3.description: Third line of the street address.

city.title: The City Schema
city.description: The location's city, town, or village.

state.title: The State Schema
state.description: The state or region of the location, such as a province, state, or prefecture.

postal_code.title: The Postal_code Schema
postal_code.description: The postal code of the location (also known as zip code, postcode, Eircode, etc.).

company.title: The Company Schema
company.description: The name of the company associated to the address.

first_name.title: The First_name Schema
first_name.description: The first name of the person associated to the address.

last_name.title: The Last_name Schema
last_name.description: The last name of the person associated to the address.

email.title: The Email Schema
email.description: The email address of the person associated to the address.

phone.description: The phone number of the person associated to the address.

Opening_hour_period.v1.title: OpeningHourPeriod
Opening_hour_period.v1.description: The `OpeningHourPeriod` model provides detailed information about a location's operating hours for a specific day. It includes the start and end times, and indicates whether the location is open on that particular day.

open.description: Indicate whether the store is open on this day. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `true`.

from.description: The start time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

to.description: The end time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

Opening_hours.v1.description: The regular opening hours of the location.
Opening_hours.v1.title: OpeningHours
